title: Anvil Tide
description: A single noise-blasted bass percussion hit hammered out in shifting euclidean and ply gates, with a hard pitch-envelope thud and a metallic bandpass ring. Across 32 cycles the noise blend, crush, bandpass ring and gating density crawl on separate clocks, so the hit drifts from a dry low knock into a gargling, clanging metallic strike.
code:
setcpm(138/4)
stack(
  note("c1").s("square")
    .struct("<x(3,8) x(5,8) x(3,8,1) x(7,8)>")
    .ply("<1 1 2 1 3>/2")
    .noise(sine.slow(29).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .penv("<26 20 32 16>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay("<0.05 0.08 0.04>/8")
    .bpf(sine.slow(17).range(180, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(23).range(9, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(3).lpattack(0.003).lpdecay(0.12)
    .crush(saw.slow(31).range(16, 4))
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.25, 0.7)).distort("<0 0.3 0.5 0.2>/8")
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.18).sustain(0).release(0.05)
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.coarse("<2 4 8>").speed(-1))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .off(1/16, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).crush(5).bpf(3200))
    .room(0.18).postgain(0.92).gain(0.95)
)
